findingClass: a required document type (DRHP/RHP/PROSPECTUS) on a live-window IPO is stuck in extraction (MANUAL_REVIEW, EXTRACT_FAILED, FAILED behind a HARD_FAILURE marker, FAILED repeatedly WITHOUT ever escalating to a HARD_FAILURE marker or MANUAL_REVIEW, or - since #959 removed the extraction backoff timer - any FAILED row parked until a new extractor version or new bytes (including an UNFINISHED_EXHAUSTED park), or an IN_PROGRESS row never resumed or parked) with nothing FAIL-level watching it; OR (#583) ANY document type at the retry ceiling (the 10-attempt block, or retry_count >= 10), whatever its age
sourceTask: round-5 review-of-the-reviews (#333 follow-up); 4th shape added T-494 (#396, spawnSync ETIMEDOUT never escalating); 5th shape (retry ceiling, any type, any age, with ipo/doc/type/kind/cause) #583; parked-FAILED and IN_PROGRESS shapes #959; UNFINISHED_EXHAUSTED any-type any-age shape #959 round 3
failThreshold: any UPCOMING/OPEN/CLOSED/LISTED IPO's DRHP/RHP/PROSPECTUS document has extraction_status=MANUAL_REVIEW, a sibling document_fetch_state.state=EXTRACT_FAILED, extraction_status=FAILED with an extraction_error starting HARD_FAILURE:, OR extraction_status=FAILED with retry_count between 3 and MAX_EXTRACTION_ATTEMPTS(10) exclusive and NO HARD_FAILURE: marker, OR (#959) any other extraction_status=FAILED row (UNFINISHED_EXHAUSTED parks included), OR (#959) extraction_status=IN_PROGRESS, for more than 48h; OR (#583) a document of ANY type on such an IPO is at the retry ceiling (MANUAL_REVIEW with a blocked_after_10_attempts marker, or retry_count >= 10), at ANY age, reported with ipo id, document id, type, kind and last cause; OR (#959 round 3) a document of ANY type on such an IPO is parked FAILED with an extraction_error starting UNFINISHED_EXHAUSTED: (its unfinished reads reached their count cap), at ANY age, reported with ipo id, document id, type, count/cap, cause and last error
unverifiableWhen: never - always runs against documents/document_fetch_state joined to ipos
